en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, from his<sup>asws</sup> forefathers<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The Hajj, its Reward is the Paradise, and the Umra is an expiation of every sin’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father, from al-Nawfaliy from al-Sakuniy who has said the following from his ancestors: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause,
has said, ‘The reward for performing Hajj is paradise and ‘Umrah is expiation for all sins.”
